row.evidence: Bitly's pricing page lists "SSO logins" only under Enterprise (Get a Quote), and its help centre says "SSO is included with every Enterprise subscription" with SCIM 1.1 and 2.0 for automated provisioning and deprovisioning.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SSO and SCIM are Enterprise only (custom pricing). Flat plans unchanged: Free, Core $10/mo (annual only), Growth $29/mo annual ($35 monthly), Premium $199/mo annual ($300 monthly). Bitly's help centre says SCIM is not supported with Microsoft Entra ID (Entra gallery app is SAML + JIT only); Okta's 'Bitly Enterprise' OIN app supports SAML and SCIM create/update/deactivate. No public SCIM endpoint docs (base URL, attributes) and no admin user-management API: the v4 API only exposes the authenticated user (GET/PATCH /user) and groups.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Includes multiple users, group permissions, SSO logins and activity log.

scim.notes: Help centre says Bitly supports 'SCIM 1.1 and 2.0'. No SCIM setup guide, endpoint or attribute documentation is public.

operations.notes: From Okta's Bitly Enterprise OIN app (Create, Update, Deactivate checked in page markup) and Bitly's 'provisioning and deprovisioning' statement.

limitations.text: SCIM provisioning is not supported with Microsoft Entra ID; Entra users must be provisioned manually (or via JIT).

user_api.notes: The public v4 API (links, QR codes, groups, organizations, webhooks) has no endpoints to list, create, invite or remove account users; only the authenticated user's own record.

capabilities.notes: false = not present in the published OpenAPI spec; PATCH /user updates only the authenticated user.

audit_log_api.notes: An in-app Activity log exists on Enterprise; no API for it in the v4 spec.

okta.notes: 'Bitly Enterprise' OIN app (last updated Jan 2020): SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate checked in page markup. A separate 'Bitly Free' app exists (https://www.okta.com/integrations/bitly-free/), not loaded.

google.notes: Bitly lists Google G Suite as a supported SSO IdP; Google's catalogue page not checked.

onelogin.notes: Bitly lists OneLogin as a supported SSO IdP.

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-bitly could not be loaded (403 / render failure).

fallbacks.notes: Admins can export users as a file; no CSV user import documented.
